newsitem.title: USA: First of America places securities.
newsitem.headline: First of America places securities.

text.p: First of America Bank Corp said Tuesday it placed $150 million of fixed rated capital securities through First of America Capital Trust I, a newly formed Delaware business trust.
The trust is controlled by First of America.
The 8.12 percent capital securities were priced at par, it added.
Cash distributions will be payable semi-annually on January 31 and July 31, beginning July 31, 1997, it said.
The proceeds from the issuance will be used for general corporate purposes.
"We believe the issuance of these capital securities will further enhance our strong capital position, while reducing our cost of capital," Richard Chormann, chairman, said in a statement.
